title: Part 1 Free Practice Set
note: Look at each photo, play the audio (four statements), then choose A–D. Immediate feedback. No class code.

items.imageAlt: A man in a suit facing forward in a professional portrait.
items.narratorScript: Look at the picture. Mark your answer on your answer sheet.

statements.text: He's adjusting his necktie in front of a mirror.
He's wearing a suit and looking toward the camera.
He's handing a folder to a colleague.
He's sitting at a desk and typing on a laptop.

items.correctAnswer: He's wearing a suit and looking toward the camera.
items.explanation: The photo shows a man in a suit facing forward. B matches what we can see. A, C, and D add actions or objects that are not visible.
items.commonMistake: Choosing C or D because office scenes often include folders or laptops, even when they are not in this photo.

items.imageAlt: Several colleagues gathered around a table with a laptop.
items.narratorScript: Look at the picture. Mark your answer on your answer sheet.

statements.text: They're standing in line at a ticket counter.
One person is giving a speech on a stage.
They're looking at a laptop together at a table.
They're packing boxes in a warehouse.

items.correctAnswer: They're looking at a laptop together at a table.
items.explanation: The photo shows a group around a table focused on a laptop. C describes that. A, B, and D describe different workplace scenes.
items.commonMistake: Picking A because people are close together, without checking that there is no ticket counter.

items.imageAlt: Stacked cardboard boxes in a warehouse aisle.
items.narratorScript: Look at the picture. Mark your answer on your answer sheet.

statements.text: Boxes are stacked along a warehouse aisle.
A clerk is scanning items at a checkout counter.
A gardener is watering plants outdoors.

items.correctAnswer: Boxes are stacked along a warehouse aisle.
items.explanation: The photo clearly shows stacked boxes in a storage/warehouse setting. A matches. The other options describe unrelated places.
items.commonMistake: Choosing B by assuming any indoor work scene must be retail checkout.
